title: veronica anagallis-aquatica subsp. undulata
intro: Veronica anagallis-aquatica subsp. undulata, commonly known as Water Speedwell, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Plantaginaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Water Speedwell include antipyretic, anti-diarrheal, and anti-catarrhal effects, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Water Speedwell include iridoids, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, such as aucubin, baicalein, and verbascoside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
